public_rationale: Marcus forecast that in 2029 AI will not be able to reliably build bug-free code of more than 10,000 lines from a natural-language specification. The deadline has not passed, so the forecast is recorded now and reviewed after 2029.
limitations: The live post says it was edited ('later clarification, italics added June 2024'). An Internet Archive copy near 2022-06-01 contains the same sentence, but the fetcher labelled that copy a preview, so it is not stored as full context.
No test procedure for 'reliably' and 'bug-free' is fixed yet.
